note: Canonical entry for timer A (TA1/TA2OEN, hrtim_tima::outr CHP); the same rule applies per-timer A..F (TB..TF OEN gated by the corresponding hrtim_timb..f::outr CHP1/CHP2).

constraint.consequence: Enabling an HRTIM output (TxyOEN) before the chopper is configured drives the output without the intended chopper modulation.
constraint.datasheet_text: CHP1 and CHP2 bits must be set prior to the output enable done with TxyOEN bits in the HRTIM_OENR register.

note: Scope: runtime set-point adjustment (re-writing preloadable timing registers while the timer runs). Canonical entry = timer A CMP1R gated by HRTIM_CR.TAUDIS; the same applies to the other preloadable timer-A registers (SET/RST/CMP/PER/DTxR) and to timers B..F via their T{B..F}UDIS bits. Not required for the initial pre-enable configuration.

constraint.consequence: Writing a preloadable HRTIM timing register during a software set-point change without first freezing updates (TxUDIS) risks a partial transfer into the active registers on a concurrent hardware update event.
constraint.datasheet_text: When the power converter set-point has to be adjusted by software, TAUDIS, TDUDIS and TEUDIS bits of the HRTIM_CR register must be set prior to write accessing the registers to update the values (for instance the compare values). From this time on, any hardware update request is ignored and the preload registers can be accessed without any risk to have them transferred into the active registers.
